findings.defect: Initial A2C setting caused bright partial-alpha artifacts
findings.evidence: White dotted edges across both original B4 views; removed in repaired captures.
findings.cause: Three.js ALPHA_TO_COVERAGE keeps partial output alpha while renderer antialias:false provides no MSAA coverage. Disabling the incompatible option repairs the captured edges.
findings.action: Reject original B4 alpha setting; keep its images as a renderer-negative example.

findings.defect: Fibres still have a stylized flat-strip character
findings.evidence: Near silhouettes curve and overlap more naturally than B3 but remain plainly geometric; overall scene is not yet concept quality.
findings.action: Accept integration provisionally for the foreground composition test only; no scene approval or global style approval.

implementation: Five-segment related curved fibres, shared world pigment/light, no card shadows; technical repair disables A2C on the non-MSAA renderer without changing the artistic construction.
demonstrated: Repaired hero/inspection show growth emerging from the ground with matching bases, connected directional lean, no opaque mound footprint, no hard individual grass shadows, and substantially less coarse triangular silhouette. Narrow integration gate passes; full composition remains unproven.
failure: Unrepaired alpha configuration failed; remaining strips and smooth distant horizon keep scene short of target. Triangle cost rose substantially and needs real mobile validation.
reusable: Shared root pigment and avoiding individual grass shadow maps improve integration in this case. A2C must be conditioned on real multisample support.
specific: Curved dry-grass fibres and 2800-instance budget are not global defaults.
humanFeedbackNeeded: Neither material nor grass is human-approved. Assess the complete composition next.
supportScope: Repaired seed-29 root/pigment integration only; does not approve silhouette style, cost, or the entire landscape.
